name: mortgage-calculator
description: Mortgage calculator: frontend, API contract, Python backend and Supabase.

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:backend:check: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run format:backend:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:scenarios
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --env-file .env
